## TRA Timeline

#### IPO registration and form-of TRA

- 2026-04-17: S-1 first describes the contemplated TRA in the offering narrative
- 2026-05-04: S-1/A No. 2 files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.2 (preamble date placeholder; signature blocks blank)
- 2026-05-12?: IPO prices at $15.00 per share (424B5); TRA contemplated to be executed at IPO closing three business days later

## Explanation

GMR Solutions Inc. is a corporate holding company (parent of Global Medical Response) that filed a sponsor-IPO TRA in connection with its May 12, 2026 IPO. The contract obligates the PubCo to pay 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits to pre-IPO holders (KKR, Koch, Ares, HPS, plus current and former employees electing to participate) on a defined snapshot of pre-IPO corporate tax attributes: NOLs, deferred interest expense, tax credits, IPO-date amortization and depreciation, Section 174 capitalization, debt-issuance-cost deductions, and IPO-related deductions. The agreement is unexecuted as of the latest filing in the directory; the executed instrument is expected at closing and is flagged origin-date-unverified. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
